settings.heading: What are custom temporary tattoos, and how are they made?
settings.row_content: Custom temporary tattoos are personalized fake tattoos created by printing your own custom design or image onto temporary tattoo paper. You can upload your design, photo, or art to create your own custom temporary tattoos. These tattoos are a fun way to get creative with coloring for events, parties, or just for fun with friends.

settings.heading: How long do custom temporary tattoos last?
settings.row_content:
Custom temporary tattoos typically last 3-5 days when properly applied, but the duration can vary depending on your skin type, how well you follow the application instructions, and how much friction or rubbing the tattoo receives. Proper care helps custom tattoos last longer. They are water resistant, so they won't wash off easily in the shower or pool.

Want your custom tattoos to last longer? Our INKFINITY™ semi-permanent tattoos are designed to provide a realistic tattoo experience for up to 2 weeks.

settings.heading: Can I create my own design for custom temporary tattoos?
settings.row_content: Yes, you can create your own design to be printed as custom temporary tattoos! Simply upload your design file, image, photo or artwork. You can also use our online design tool to create a completely custom design from scratch with text, graphics, and more.

settings.heading: What is the minimum order quantity?
settings.row_content: Our current minimum order quantity for regular printed custom temporary tattoos is 200 units. For semi-permanent custom temporary tattoos, the minimum order is just 1 unit. Specialty finishes like metallic ink, glitter, or glow-in-the-dark tattoos have a 1000 unit minimum order.

settings.heading: Are custom tattoos safe for skin?
settings.row_content: All our products are tested annually to ensure they meet an extensive list of US regulations and requirements. Our custom temporary tattoos are generally considered safe for most skin types. However, we recommend doing a patch test if you have sensitive skin or known allergies to adhesives before applying custom fake tattoos.

settings.heading: How do I apply and remove custom temporary tattoos?
settings.row_content: To apply custom temporary tattoos, place the tattoo on clean, dry skin and press a damp cloth over it for 30 seconds. To remove, use baby oil or rubbing alcohol and gently rub to peel off the custom tattoo. Our Tattoo Remover Wipes are also made for easily removing custom temporary tattoos.

settings.heading: Can I order custom tattoos for events?
settings.row_content: Absolutely! Custom temporary tattoos are perfect for birthday parties, weddings, special events and more. They allow you to create personalized designs that stick right on the skin and wear all night.

settings.heading: Do you offer one color custom tattoos?
settings.row_content: Yes, in addition to full color, we can print custom temporary tattoos in just one color like black or white ink.

settings.heading: Do you offer specialty custom tattoos?
settings.row_content: In addition to standard printed custom temporary tattoos, we offer specialty options like custom metallic tattoos made with custom glitter tattoos with a sparkly finish, and custom glow-in-the-dark tattoos created with luminescent glow ink.

settings.heading: Can I customize the size and shape?
settings.row_content: Absolutely. We provide customization options to adjust the size and shape of your custom temporary tattoos. Choose from pre-set sizes or request a completely custom shape tailored to your needs.

settings.heading: How do I order?
settings.row_content: Ordering custom temporary tattoos is easy on our site. Simply upload your artwork file, create a new design using our tool, select your desired quantity and product options, and complete the order checkout process online.Contact us if you need any assistance.

settings.heading: What is the turnaround time?
settings.row_content: Most standard custom temporary tattoo orders ship within 5-7 business days. Note that specialty products like metallic or glow tattoos require additional production time. Contact us for an exact shipping timeline.

settings.heading: How will I get my order's tracking details?
settings.row_content: Once your custom temporary tattoo order ships from our facility, you'll receive a shipping confirmation email with tracking information so you can view the delivery status. See our Shipping & Returns page for full details.

settings.heading: What if my design doesn't meet guidelines?
settings.row_content: Any custom designs submitted for temporary tattoos go through a review process to ensure they follow production and content guidelines. If we cannot print your design as-is, our team will reach out to explain why and work with you on an alternative that meets requirements.

settings.heading: Can I get application tutorials?
settings.row_content: Yes, we provide full application instructions to ensure your custom temporary tattoos are applied properly for best results. Check out our General Info page or contact us for application tips.

settings.heading: Can I get custom tattoos to cover an area?
settings.row_content: Our custom temporary tattoos can be printed in a variety of sizes to cover larger areas like the back, shoulders, arms or legs if desired. Just let us know the dimensions you need covered when ordering.

settings.heading: Are there different types of temporary tattoos available?
settings.row_content: Yes, we offer various types, including custom metallic tattoos, custom glitter tattoos, and custom glow in the dark tattoos. For longer lasting power, please explore our INKFINITY™ semi-permanent collections that can be customized, as well.
